conventions.position: three.js world metres (Y-up), eye point of the panorama
conventions.yawOffset: radians; three.js camera yaw (rotation.y, YXZ order; 0 looks along -Z, +pi/2 looks along -X) of the panorama CENTRE column (u = 0.5). u grows to the right (clockwise seen from above). Seam at u = 0/1 faces away.
conventions.links: indices into the same panos array (same room, or rooms connected by a door/opening/glass door, < 9 m)
conventions.files: repo-relative paths (the Pages site serves them at the same relative path)
